verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a recurring-execution capability is the feature-status listing of supported refreshable materialized views, which periodically re-run a defining query. The docs only name the feature and do not describe scheduling. SQL alert rules with an interval (docs-21) are adjacent monitoring, not general job scheduling, and batch tasks (docs-15) are one-off rather than recurring. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose job/workflow scheduler, cron-style schedule configuration, schedule management via API/CLI/MCP for agents, and hands-on corroboration.
